mapping_scope: General HPO mapping for textual claims; native lab item and discrete state for laboratory claims; retain unsupported concepts
match_target: Facts visible in this rollout input_view_id only
exact_definition: Same concept meaning, explicitly expressed state/assertion and required qualifiers; synonyms allowed only when semantic specificity is preserved
partial_definition: Broader concept or omitted required site, degree, state or other modifier; not exact coverage
contradiction_definition: Explicit incompatible assertion or state on an identifiable patient feature
ambiguous_definition: Multiple unresolved concepts/items/values or uncertain alignment
no_visible_fact_definition: No counterpart in the actual visible input; underlying TRACE record association is separate

primary_coverage.denominator: all visible facts/groups for that admission, including explicit negatives and visible lab states

constraints: Never fill omitted claim values from patient records
Never add unmentioned patient facts during missed-mention review
HPO identifier is not a fact identifier
Preserve general claims even when unmatched or contradictory
Matching is not a clinical correctness or causal judgment
Review changes annotations only; original rollout immutable
